rinku.options.user_agent.desc: Overrides the browser user agent. Leave blank to use Rinku's default product identifier. Requires a game restart.
rinku.options.use_cache.desc: Stores browser cache, cookies, and session data between launches. Requires a game restart.
rinku.options.enable_widevine.desc: Passes the Widevine CDM enable switch to CEF for DRM-capable media. Requires a game restart.
rinku.options.preload_enabled.desc: Keeps browser instances ready to reduce the delay when a browser is requested.
rinku.options.preload_transparent_pool_s: Number of transparent browser instances kept ready (0-4).
rinku.options.preload_opaque_pool_size.d: Number of opaque browser instances kept ready (0-4).
rinku.options.skip_download.desc: Skips Rinku's automatic JCEF installation and update flow. Use only with a separately provisioned runtime; applies on the next launch.
rinku.options.download_mirror_policy.des: Controls whether downloads use the official mirror, prefer the configured mirror, or require the configured mirror. Applies on the next download.
rinku.options.download_mirror.desc: Base HTTPS URL for a configured JCEF release mirror. Applies on the next download.
rinku.options.enforce_checksums.desc: Requires downloaded JCEF archives to match their SHA-256 checksum. Disabling this weakens download integrity protection.
rinku.options.connect_timeout.desc: Connection timeout in milliseconds for JCEF downloads (1,000-300,000).
rinku.options.read_timeout.desc: Read timeout in milliseconds for JCEF downloads (1,000-300,000).
rinku.options.max_archive_bytes.desc: Maximum permitted compressed JCEF archive size in bytes (1,048,576-5,242,880,000).
rinku.options.max_checksum_bytes.desc: Maximum permitted checksum response size in bytes (512-1,048,576).
rinku.options.max_extracted_bytes.desc: Maximum permitted extracted JCEF size in bytes (1,048,576-10,485,760,000).
rinku.options.disable_web_security.desc: Disables CEF same-origin web security. This is unsafe for untrusted content and requires a game restart.
rinku.options.native_log_severity.desc: Minimum severity written by CEF's native logger. Requires a game restart.
rinku.options.console_log_severity.desc: Minimum browser console severity forwarded to the Minecraft log. Disable prevents forwarding.
rinku.options.validation.user_agent: Enter a valid user agent or leave the field blank.
rinku.options.validation.download_mirror: Enter a valid HTTPS mirror URL. Configured-only mode requires a non-empty URL.
rinku.options.validation.integer_range: Enter a whole number from %s to %s.
